q_A: SELECT T2.feature_type_name FROM Other_Available_Features AS T1 JOIN Ref_Feature_Types AS T2 ON T1.feature_type_code = T2.feature_type_code WHERE T1.feature_name = "AirCon"
gold_q_B: SELECT "t2"."characteristics_type_name" AS "feature_type_name" FROM "Other_Available_Features" AS "t1" JOIN "Ref_Feature_Types" AS "t2" ON "t1"."attribute_type_num" = "t2"."attribute_category_number" WHERE "t1"."attribute_appellation" = 'AirCon'

q_A: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code = T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code
